gap_report_metadata.requirement_title: As a customer, I want to browse available mobile devices, review product details and default configurations, view promotional offers and estimated delivery information, authenticate when required, and seamlessly continue my purchase journey after successful login, so that I can make an informed purchase decision and complete my mobile device purchase successfully.

partially_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC3 – Default Product Configuration (Partially Covered) - When the Product Details Page is opened, the application shall: Display the default device colour. Display the default storage option. Display the default payment option. Display the correct pricing for the default configuration. Display the estimated delivery date. Display the promotional offer (if available).
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify default device configuration displays correct values for Colour, Storage, and Payment option on Samsung Galaxy A57 5G details page
partially_mapped_criteria.gap_analysis: Sub-conditions for default colour, storage, and payment option are verified by TC658. However, sub-conditions for correct pricing display, estimated delivery date display, and promotional offer display (if available) are not verified by any test case. Three out of six sub-conditions remain untested. Missing verification for: correct pricing display for default configuration, estimated delivery date display, and promotional offer display (if available).
recommended_test_enhancements: Create new test cases to verify: (1) correct pricing is displayed based on default configuration (colour, storage, payment option), (2) estimated delivery date is visible and accurate, and (3) promotional offer is displayed when available and hidden when not applicable.
Add step 9: Verify the device price is displayed and matches expected pricing for default configuration (Black, 256GB, 24-month).
Add step 10: Verify estimated delivery date is displayed in expected format (e.g., 'Estimated delivery: [date]').
Add step 11: Verify promotional offer section is displayed if offer is available, or hidden if no offer exists.

partially_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC4 – Continue Purchase Journey (Partially Covered) - The customer shall be able to: View the Next button. Click the Next button. Continue to the next purchase step. Prevent duplicate submissions when the button is clicked multiple times. Resume the purchase journey after successful authentication.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify Next button is interactable and initiates the next step in purchase journey
partially_mapped_criteria.gap_analysis: Sub-conditions for viewing the Next button, clicking it, and continuing to next step are verified by TC659. However, sub-conditions for preventing duplicate submissions and resuming purchase journey after successful authentication are not verified by TC659. Two out of five sub-conditions remain untested. Missing verification for: preventing duplicate submissions when Next button is clicked multiple times, and resuming purchase journey after successful authentication.
recommended_test_enhancements: Create new test cases to verify: (1) Next button implements debounce or disable mechanism to prevent duplicate submissions during rapid clicks, and (2) after successful login, user is redirected back to the exact purchase step they were on (PDP with selected configuration intact).
Add step 7: Rapidly click the Next button multiple times (3-5 clicks within 1 second) and verify only one action is triggered.
Add step 8: After authentication popup appears, complete login and verify user is redirected back to PDP with configuration intact.

partially_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC5 – Authentication (Partially Covered) - If the customer is not authenticated, the application shall: Display the Login popup after clicking Next. Display Login and Sign Up options. Prevent the purchase journey until authentication is completed. Redirect the customer back to the interrupted purchase step after successful login.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify login or sign-up popup is displayed with correct message and action buttons when unauthenticated user clicks Next
partially_mapped_criteria.gap_analysis: Sub-conditions for displaying Login popup after clicking Next and displaying Login and Sign Up options are verified by TC660. However, sub-conditions for preventing purchase journey until authentication is completed and redirecting customer back to interrupted purchase step after successful login are not verified by any test case. Two out of four sub-conditions remain untested. Missing verification for: preventing purchase journey until authentication is completed, and redirecting customer back to interrupted purchase step after successful login.
recommended_test_enhancements: Create new test cases to verify: (1) purchase journey is blocked and user cannot proceed without completing authentication, and (2) after successful login via popup, user is automatically redirected to the interrupted purchase step with context preserved (device selection, configuration).
Add step 10: Attempt to close the popup without logging in and verify user cannot proceed with purchase.
Add step 11: Complete login via 'Log in with Hub ID' button.
Add step 12: Verify user is redirected back to Samsung Galaxy A57 5G PDP with device configuration preserved.

partially_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC6 – Error Handling (Partially Covered) - The application shall gracefully handle error scenarios including: Network interruption while loading pages. Device unavailability or out-of-stock condition. Slow network response while loading the Product Details Page. HTTP 500/Internal Server Error. API timeout while retrieving product details. Display appropriate error messages without crashing.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify system behavior when user attempts to navigate to All Phones with network interruption
partially_mapped_criteria.gap_analysis: Sub-condition for network interruption while loading pages is verified by TC661. However, sub-conditions for device unavailability/out-of-stock, slow network response on PDP, HTTP 500/Internal Server Error, API timeout while retrieving product details, and appropriate error message display without crashing are not comprehensively verified. Only one out of six sub-conditions is fully tested. Missing verification for: device unavailability/out-of-stock condition, slow network response while loading PDP, HTTP 500/Internal Server Error, API timeout while retrieving product details, and comprehensive error message display without application crash.
recommended_test_enhancements: Create new test cases to verify: (1) device unavailability or out-of-stock displays appropriate messaging and prevents purchase, (2) slow network on PDP shows loading indicators and eventually loads or times out gracefully, (3) HTTP 500 errors display user-friendly error messages with retry options, (4) API timeout scenarios are handled with appropriate error messages, and (5) all error scenarios display meaningful messages without application crash.
Create test case for device unavailability/out-of-stock condition with appropriate user messaging.
Create test case for slow network response on PDP with loading indicators and timeout handling.
Create test case for HTTP 500/Internal Server Error with user-friendly error messages and retry options.
Create test case for API timeout while retrieving product details with graceful error handling.
Verify all error scenarios display meaningful messages without application crash.

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC1 – Mobile Devices Listing (Fully Covered) - The customer shall be able to: Navigate from the StarHub Home page to Mobile → All Phones. View the Mobile Devices listing page. Verify the page heading is displayed correctly. Verify the correct URL is loaded. View all available mobile devices.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify user can successfully navigate to Mobile Devices listing page from StarHub personal homepage

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC2 – Product Details Page (Fully Covered) - The customer shall be able to: Select Samsung Galaxy A57 5G from the device listing. Navigate to the Product Details Page. Verify the product information. Verify the Product Details Page URL.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify user can select Samsung Galaxy A57 5G device from All Phones listing and navigate to device details page

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC7 – Responsive Authentication Popup (Fully Covered) - The application shall ensure that the authentication popup: Displays correctly on Desktop. Displays correctly on Tablet. Displays correctly on Mobile. Maintains usability across supported screen resolutions.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify authentication popup displays correctly and remains functional across different viewport sizes
